title: Automatic Thematic Indexing of Large Literary Corpora: A Machine Learning Approach to Voltaire's Complete Works
abstract: arXiv:2607.09316v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Thematic indexing -- the practice of assigning structured conceptual labels to sections of text -- is essential to scholarly access in large-scale literary and historical editions, yet it remains a largely manual, labour-intensive process. This paper explores the application of machine learning to automatic thematic indexing, using two substantial sub-corpora of the Complete Works of Voltaire as a test case: the Essai sur les m\oe urs et l'esprit des nations and the Questions sur l'Encyclop\'edie. The task is framed as a multi-label classification problem, in which a model must assign the set of index entries that a professional indexer would apply to a given page of text. translated_title: 大型文学语料库的自动主题索引：一种应用于伏尔泰全集的机器学习方法
translated_abstract: 主题索引——即为文本片段赋予结构化概念标签的做法——对于大型文学和历史版本的学术检索至关重要，然而这一过程在很大程度上仍然依赖人工，劳动密集。本文探讨了将机器学习应用于自动主题索引，并以《伏尔泰全集》的两个重要子语料库作为测试案例：《论各民族的风俗与精神》（Essai sur les mœurs et l'esprit des nations）和《百科全书问题》（Questions sur l'Encyclopédie）。该任务被构建为一个多标签分类问题，即模型需要为给定的一页文本分配专业索引员所会使用的索引条目集合。我们比较了一系列方法——从带有分类头的编码器模型到通过低秩适应微调的生成式大语言模型（LLM）——涵盖约30亿至1200亿参数的模型规模。
tldr: 本文将专业索引员为伏尔泰全集文本页面分配主题索引条目的任务构建为多标签分类问题，比较了从编码器模型到LoRA微调的大语言模型等多种方法，实现了大型文学语料库主题索引的自动化，替代传统人工流程。
en_tdlr: This paper frames automatic thematic indexing of Voltaire's complete works as a multi-label classification task, comparing encoder-based models with LoRA-fine-tuned LLMs spanning 3 to 120 billion parameters to automate a traditionally manual scholarly process.
